mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 43 degrees with clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. Please be aware that the air quality is currently moderate with an index of 70, and the waxing gibbous moon is visible tonight.

City news today focuses on the ongoing Mark Drive reconstruction. Phase two utility work is now finished, gravel bases are down, and concrete work is moving along on the west block. Additionally, remember that the city offers a helpful toilet rebate program and an Eye-On-Water monitoring tool to help manage your utility usage.

We have a busy schedule of local happenings. Today, you can check out Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory or enjoy pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, make sure to visit ART House 360 for bar happy hours or catch Hop Haus Trivia. Later this week, Bailey's Run Vineyard will host live music on Thursday.
In our police report for the week, the department arrested a school bus driver for O W I on Wednesday, October 15, following reports of dangerous driving behavior while transporting students.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. If you are planning a visit, the store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
